newsitem.title: JAPAN: Green Cross to form restructuring plan by mid-Oct.
newsitem.headline: Green Cross to form restructuring plan by mid-Oct.

text.p: Japanese drug maker Green Cross Corp's new president Kazunari Doi told a news conference on Thursday that the firm would formulate a restructuring plan by mid-October.

The company earlier revised downward its earnings forecast for the first half of the 1996/97 business year, saying it now expects no parent current profit compared with its previous forecast of two billion yen profit.

The firm's three former presidents were arrested earlier this month on suspicion of professional negligence resulting in death for their roles in sales of HIV-contaminated blood products. HIV is the virus that causes AIDS.
Since the arrests, many medical institutions have begun to boycott Green Cross's products, Doi said.
